status: registered before any content-control run; the only prior outputs are the MS-131 real-arm answers (answers_seed1.jsonl) and the untrained text-only answers
question: Does the frozen EarthTalk G-L1 projector (seed 1) + Olmo-3-7B-Instruct answer the landslide Q1 question from the OlmoEarth embedding, or from the prompt text (dates)?

model.embeddings: /home/work/data/olmoearth/olmo_streaming_dev/single_fp16/<tile>.npy (OlmoEarth v1 Base, 4x4 avg-pooled to 64 tokens/date, plus d2-d1 tokens)
model.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens 16, identical prompt template and parser to code/earthtalk_projector_train.py

data.items: /home/work/data/olmoearth/sentinel_qa_v0_1/items.jsonl, type Q1 (and Q3 for a secondary check), restricted to tiles whose embedding file exists (MS-131 used 384 Q1 = 192 tiles)
data.structure: each tile has one positive item (date pair spanning the landslide, answer yes) and one negative item (later date pair on the same tile, answer no)
known_limits: exposed evaluation set: MS-131 already reported the real arm on these items
two regions only; tiles within a region are not independent
the model is conservative (MS-131 recall .26, FPR .047), which bounds any effect near .21

arms.swap_within_tile: source prompt text (its dates), embedding from the OTHER item of the same tile (pos<->neg). Location, region and prompt form are held fixed; only the embedded observations differ
arms.zero_embedding: source prompt, all EO input tokens set to zero before the projector (the projector still emits tokens, so the sequence length is unchanged)
arms.swap_cross_tile: source prompt, embedding from a different tile in the same region whose item has the opposite answer; donor chosen deterministically by sha256(seed|source id)

metrics.d_real: P(yes | gold yes) - P(yes | gold no) in the real arm (= recall - FPR)
metrics.d_swap: in swap_within_tile: P(yes | embedding from the positive item) - P(yes | embedding from the negative item). Because each tile contributes one item of each kind with the texts exchanged, d_swap > 0 means answers follow the embedding and d_swap < 0 means they follow the prompt text
metrics.d_zero: in zero_embedding: P(yes | positive prompt text) - P(yes | negative prompt text), i.e. the date-text cue with the embedding removed
metrics.d_cross: in swap_cross_tile: P(yes | donor embedding positive) - P(yes | donor embedding negative)
metrics.balanced_acc: per arm, against the source gold (and against the donor gold for swap arms)
metrics.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap over tiles (2000 resamples, seed 20260925); both items of a tile move together
metrics.q3_secondary: Q3 with swap_cross_tile donors having a different quadrant set: Jaccard vs donor minus Jaccard vs source. Descriptive only

validity_checks.reproduction: real-arm parsed answers must equal answers_seed1.jsonl on >= 95% of Q1 items; otherwise verdict = invalid_run
validity_checks.parse: parse failure <= 10% in every arm; otherwise verdict = invalid_run
validity_checks.signal: if d_real < 0.10 on the rerun, there is too little signal to transfer and the verdict is uninformative_low_signal

primary_verdict.reads_embedding: d_swap >= 0.10 AND bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
primary_verdict.follows_text: d_swap <= -0.10 AND bootstrap CI upper bound < 0
primary_verdict.not_demonstrated: any other valid outcome (includes small or uncertain d_swap)

supporting_reading: reads_embedding is strengthened if d_cross >= 0.10 with CI lower > 0 and |d_zero| < 0.05; these are reported but do not change the primary verdict
what_this_does_not_show: that the model reads landslide content well (recall is low); only whether its answers depend on the embedding
anything about other phenomena, other regions or other projectors
that a trained text-only model would score .500; the MS-131 text-only arm was zero-shot

next_step_by_verdict.reads_embedding: E1 multi-phenomenon audit and E2 training with the same controls
next_step_by_verdict.follows_text: treat MS-131 .607 as a text/date cue; redesign E2 training (e.g. swap-based negatives) and re-measure with these controls
next_step_by_verdict.not_demonstrated: same as follows_text for planning; report the effect size and CI as is
next_step_by_verdict.invalid_run / uninformative_low_signal: fix the reproduction path before any interpretation; no threshold changes

compute: single GPU, about 1,700 generations of 16 tokens; run only when the chosen GPU has no other process (CLAUDE.md 4b)
